items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: I never was a fan of his too much at all.

ctx.x: Yeah, Jimi Hendrix. I never was a fan of his too much at all. I liked more of the blues, the old Texas blues guys that play. There was more excitement. And it seemed like they played more of the guitar.
Is there a definition for Texas swing?
